learner_operation: Apply the product rule to two factors, at least one trigonometric, and identify a complete derivative or the missing summand in a scaffolded derivative. Determine which product-rule contribution must be supplied, or select the complete derivative using the displayed factors.

fixed_features.feature: Two factors, one product-rule application, trig argument x
fixed_features.justification: Canonical e-3634 and tutorial2622 teach u'v+uv'; chain rule and point evaluation belong outside this operation.

fixed_features.feature: One blank plus supplied complementary term, or five-choice radio
fixed_features.justification: All captured response contracts have this workload; q-71004 missing response is documented as repaired full blank.

fixed_features.feature: Power n=2..4 in public polynomial profiles
fixed_features.justification: Author fixes this range, but excludes the source canonical n=1 case without an instructional reason. Demonstrated restriction in canonical-replay-gap.json.

answer_roles.observed: Rechecked in the current sample, canonical and controlled records; see coverage and canonical-current-checks.json. Either contribution can be hidden for the same factors.

counterfactuals.change: Switch missing product-rule term, exponent coefficient, or radical inner/target data at fixed remaining inputs.
counterfactuals.expected: Response follows the changed mathematical evidence.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent prompt differentiation and native grading agree; stale responses are rejected in applicable blank controls.
counterfactuals.justification: These changes alter a differentiated contribution or chain-rule factor without adding a reasoning stage.

counterfactuals.change: Change presentation/choice ordering, or an additive parameter absent from the requested derivative fragment.
counterfactuals.observed: Current controlled pairs preserve the response and native acceptance.
counterfactuals.justification: The selected source-style response depends on the differentiated mathematical evidence, not incidental presentation.

delivery.result: 143 independently chosen raw records; 112 fresh records survive the reviewed band at basis 5048. Five deterministic runner records are retained. Role coverage and visible-cue probes are recorded separately before and after filtering.

limitations: Finite tests do not prove absence of every shortcut.
Learner selection is conditional on fresh eligible candidates and a positive weight for the reviewed band; real history and future IDs were not simulated as fact.
Only easy receives this publication certificate; other advertised bands require their own certificate.
Source omissions and explicit source corrections are retained in source-analysis.json. Canonical missing answer widgets are authored completions, not recovered historical fields.
